source.split_rule: Per official CITB code: first 50 examples test; next 50 dev; shuffle the remainder with seed 10 and take up to 500 for training.
source.seed_note: The upstream prepare_data.py declares seed=10 but does not seed Python random before its split helper. This preparation applies random.Random(10) explicitly for a deterministic training subset.

leakage_check.scope: instance IDs are disjoint within every task across train/dev/test
